Because the bodies are identical and both types are rate-change message types in sibling subsystems of the same package, the duplication is structural rather than intentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `PlayerMessage`) in the `Playback` package and provide a default implementation of `makeNotification()` in a protocol extension, eliminating the per-type copies.
